segments.normalizedSource: The following example shows how to add a quick action to pause and resume a workout, with the [`prompt`](accessibilityquickactionstyle/prompt.md) style.
segments.contextBefore: If the view is disabled, the action will defer becoming active until the view is no longer disabled.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift @State private var isPaused = false var body: some View { WorkoutView(isPaused: $isPaused) .accessibilityQuickAction(style: .prompt) { Button(isPaused ? "Resume" : "Pause") { isPaused.toggle() } } } ```

segments.source: The following example shows how to add a quick action to play and pause music, with the [`outline`](accessibilityquickactionstyle/outline.md) style.
segments.normalizedSource: The following example shows how to add a quick action to play and pause music, with the [`outline`](accessibilityquickactionstyle/outline.md) style.

```swift @State private var isPlaying = false var body: some View { PlayButton(isPlaying: $isPlaying) .contentShape(.focusEffect, Circle()) .accessibilityQuickAction(style: .outline) { Button(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play") { isPlaying.toggle() } } } ```
